§6Chunk Pregenerator§f

§aFlying at high speed and the game is chugging? Yeah, that's chunk generation.§f
§9Chunk Pregenerator§f generates chunks ahead of time so your system just loads pre-existing files while you travel. No more stuttering when you're zooming around in a jetpack.

Generation runs in background threads, so you can kick off a task and keep playing without a hitch. There's also a live world profiler that shows block updates, block ticks, and ticking entities. Super useful for figuring out what's lagging your base.

You can manage everything through a GUI instead of typing console commands, which is nice.

§ePS:§f Pregenerate around your base and along travel routes. You'll thank yourself later when you're flying at full speed with zero lag.
